title: Check if a String Is an Acronym of Words
summary: Given an array of strings words and a string s, check if s matches the sequence of first characters from each word in words.
statement: Given an array of strings words and a string s, check if s matches the sequence of first characters from each word in words. Return true if s is the correct acronym, otherwise return false.
constraints: Form an acronym by taking the first character of every word in order.
Return whether that complete acronym equals s exactly.
Every input word is nonempty; no word may be skipped.
reference_solution:
def is_words_acronym(words,s):
    return ''.join(word[0] for word in words)==s
hints: The required output string is uniquely determined.
Take exactly one first character from every word.
Concatenate those characters in array order and compare the entire result with s.
Exact string equality enforces both character order and the required one-character-per-word length.
editorial: Exact string equality enforces both character order and the required one-character-per-word length.
